decisions.reason: The firm has invested in and publicly promoted the supplement range, and sunk costs and public commitment make dropping unlikely.
Launched with explicit public claims, management will persist to justify the earlier investment and visible commitment.
The joint health supplement benefits from prior investment and public launch, with no clear temporary cause to abandon it.
As a recent launch with strong public announcement and immune benefits, commitment remains high and disappointing results can be attributed to temporary market conditions.
The generic blood pressure medication is core to the firm and its recall problem is attributable to external contamination, so management will persist and reformulate rather than drop.
The OTC triptan represents a strategic OTC expansion with public commitment, and the firm will keep it to justify the investment.
